review_candidates.title: General Manager: Consumer
review_candidates.location: City of Johannesburg, Gauteng, South Africa
review_candidates.description: Fintech is entering a new phase where operational and commercial excellence has become critical for success. We at MTN believe this is a game changer in terms of our business strategy. We are looking at an incumbent to join us as we build a successful business together. Mission / Core Purpose of the Job The General Manager: Consumer is accountable for the consumer segment agenda of MTN Group Fintech, translating the approved commercial strategy into consumer propositions, go-to-market plans, customer value management programmes and decision science capability that grow active usage, customer value and revenue across the operating markets. The role leads three related sub-functions as a single segment: Consumer service value proposition management and base offer design Go-to-market planning, launch readiness and commercial activation Customer value management, campaigns, loyalty, and lifecycle management The role sets the frameworks, models, campaign standards capability through which markets execute, and works with market commercial teams to convert those frameworks into local performance. It is a principal contributor to the Consumer Growth & Lifestyle customer mission, working alongside service operations, Business Intelligence, to deliver shared customer outcomes rather than functional outputs. It is driving jointly with the markets, the consumer strategy and GTM execution. As a member of the Commercial leadership team, the General Manager contributes to the overall commercial strategy and business plan, delivers the agreed consumer targets within the approved plan and budget, and continuously improves the productivity and effectiveness of the consumer segment. Context Group Fintech is operating as a separately governed financial services business and is shifting from a wallet and USSD led model towards a digital, data driven and increasingly AI enabled commercial engine. Growth is now expected to come from deeper monetisation of the existing customer base rather than from customer acquisition alone. The incumbent must therefore deliver in the context of: A digital transition from USSD led journeys to app led engagement, requiring new activation, and lifecycle mechanics A shift in the revenue mix from basic wallet transactions towards advanced services, requiring cross-sell of all services (lending, savings, wealth, Remittance, insurance, payments and lifestyle propositions) into the consumer base Customer value management moving from scheduled campaigns towards continuous, model driven and personalised next best action at scale Rapid adoption of artificial intelligence, machine learning and automation in segmentation, propensity modelling, offer optimisation and campaign execution. A centralised commercial engine that builds capability once and enables execution in every market, while local commercial accountability remains with the operating company. Growing regulatory expectation on consumer protection, fair pricing, transparent communication, data privacy and the responsible use of customer data and models. A multicultural, expertise based organisation operating across diverse market maturities, competitive positions and regulatory environments. Agile, mission based ways of working in which outcomes are shared across service, commercial, technology and data teams. As part of your portfolio as General Manager: Consumer, you will be: Strategy Development and Implementation Contribute to the Group Fintech commercial strategy and business plan, bringing consumer insight, segment economics and analytical evidence into the enterprise planning cycle. Define the consumer segment and customer value management strategy for the Fintech consumer base, within the approved commercial strategy and frameworks. Translate the enterprise consumer agenda into an executable multi-market plan covering propositions, activation, lifecycle management, retention and monetisation. Ensure the consumer plan is aligned to the Consumer Growth & Lifestyle customer mission, with agreed shared measures across service, commercial, technology and data teams. Set the direction for the transition of consumer engagement from USSD to app led and digital channels, and define the activation and adoption mechanics required. Provide direction, frameworks, models, playbooks and roadmaps that enable consistent execution across markets, and cascade agreed targets and standards. Recommend material changes to consumer propositions, pricing constructs and commercial investment to the Executive for approval. Functional Leadership Establish, monitor and align the direction, priorities and results of the three sub-functions collectively and as individual work areas. Lead an integrated solution development and problem-solving approach across proposition, go-to-market and customer value management. Provide functional guidance to consumer and customer value management teams in markets, supporting adoption of Group frameworks, tooling and standards. Monitor value metrics that evidence the contribution of the segment to consumer revenue, customer value and cost to serve. Drive continuous improvement, simplification and automation across the segment. Represent the consumer agenda in commercial leadership forums and in cross-functional mission and planning rhythms. Delivery Leadership and Operational Oversight Consumer proposition and go-to-market Own consumer service value proposition management, including base offers, bundles, lifecycle propositions and input into pricing and service design. Own go-to-market planning, launch readiness and commercial activation for consumer propositions across markets. Drive app adoption and migration of consumer journeys from USSD to app Define the cross-sell and up-sell approach that moves consumers from basic wallet usage into advanced services. Work with market teams to ensure propositions are localised appropriately without fragmenting enterprise standards. Customer value management Design and maintain the customer value segmentation framework and the consumer lifecycle model across acquisition, activation, growth, retention and win-back. Define the customer value management framework, standards and campaign calendar for the consumer base, and oversee curated multi-market campaigns. Develop loyalty, rewards and engagement programmes across consumer segments. Oversee campaign design, production, testing, roll-out, commercial return assessment and post-implementation review. Review margins, simulations and revenue dilution to ensure campaigns and offers are commercially sound. Ensure consumer revenue contributions and associated costs are reflected in the functional budget and business plan. Ensure customer communication, offer transparency and treatment standards meet consumer protection and conduct requirements. The “Must-haves” we look for in an incumbent Education: Minimum of a four-year tertiary degree in Business Science, Commerce, Engineering, Information Technology, Statistics, Data Science or a related field. Master’s degree or MBA in Business Management, Marketing, Finance or a related field (preferred). Relevant certification in analytics, data science, digital marketing or customer value management is advantageous. Experience: Minimum of 12 to 15 years post-qualification experience, including at least 4 years in fintech, banking, payments or financial services, specifically in customer value management, consumer segment or revenue growth portfolios. Senior management track record of 5 years or more, with at least 3 years in a relevant sector. Experience leading a multi-disciplinary team across proposition, go-to-market and customer value management. Demonstrated delivery of customer value management, lifecycle and campaign programmes at scale across multiple markets. Experience applying data, machine learning and automation to commercial decision-making. Experience in digital proposition development and in migrating customers from legacy to digital channels. Deep understanding of the fintech ecosystem, players, business models and industry practice. Experience working across diverse cultures and geographies; pan-African and emerging market experience advantageous. Willing and flexible to travel within Africa and the Middle East. What will give an edge to your application Functional Knowledge: Customer proposition management and customer value management Consumer segmentation, lifecycle management and customer economics Cross-sell and up-sell, inbound and outbound Campaign and promotion management, loyalty and churn management Predictive, propensity and next best action modelling Experimentation, test and learn and performance measurement Digital service adoption, app engagement and channel migration Value model development, pricing constructs and revenue dilution analysis Consumer protection, conduct and data privacy requirements relevant to customer engagement Closing date: 18 September 2026. Late applications will not be accepted. Should you not hear from us within two weeks of the closing date, consider your application unsuccessful. Ready to make and drive the change with us. Apply now!

review_candidates.title: Especialista en vídeo digital (residencia en Córdoba, Andalucía)
review_candidates.description: Sobre XUL XUL es una agencia de comunicación y estrategia con más de 25 años de trayectoria, especializada en acompañar a lo público para generar comunicación clara, accesible y transparente desde un prisma ético y responsable. Somos una estructura 100% digital, con equipo en Sevilla, Córdoba, Cádiz, Málaga, Madrid, Barcelona, Toledo y Asturias, y agencia certificada B Corp desde 2024. Para conocernos mejor: https://xul.es/ ¿Qué buscamos? En XUL estamos reforzando nuestro equipo creativo y audiovisual, y queremos incorporar un perfil Especialista en vídeo digital, que se encargue de dar forma a los contenidos audiovisuales de nuestros proyectos de comunicación institucional. Buscamos un perfil resolutivo, con buen ojo narrativo y cómodo en creación, edición y rodaje.  ¿Cuáles serán tus funciones principales? Creación y edición de vídeo para redes sociales, web y campañas . Desarrollo de piezas narrativas para grandes campañas e ideación de formatos dinámicos y ágiles para redes sociales (reels, stories, clips).  Edición y tratamiento de audio , diseño sonoro, selección y edición de música y efectos, creación de locuciones y cuñas. Es un plus si sueles trabajar con IA para la generación de clips, creación de personajes, etc. Postproducción : corrección de color, edición de sonido y grafismos/motion graphics básicos. ¿Qué valoraremos también en tu CV? (Aunque no es imprescindible para el puesto) Tener experiencia en grabación: cámara, sonido e iluminación. Por la naturaleza de nuestros clientes, se realizan coberturas de eventos o acciones en terreno en la región de Andalucía, por lo que sería un plus que estuvieras cómodo/a en este ámbito para generar piezas de comunicación audiovisual. Tener experiencia en fotografía profesional. ¿Qué requisitos te pedimos? Titulación en Comunicación Audiovisual, Diseño o similar. Si tienes titulación en otras ramas de la comunicación como Periodismo o Publicidad, valoraremos que cuentes con formación técnica o máster relacionado con el mundo audiovisual, de diseño y/o creativo.  Mínimo 5 años de experiencia trabajando en proyectos de comunicación con material audiovisual.  Se valorará, sin ser excluyente, haber trabajado con clientes institucionales o Administración Pública en grabación, edición y postproducción de vídeo. Dominio técnico imprescindible: manejo avanzado y fluido de Adobe Premiere. Muy valorable Adobe After Effects (es un plus si sueles trabajar Motion Graphics). Residencia en Córdoba.  Para valorar tu candidatura es IMPRESCINDIBLE que enlaces en tu CV tu portfolio (Behance, Youtube, Drive, etc). Necesitamos ver, al menos, 4-5 trabajos audiovisuales diferentes para ver si encaja con el tipo de perfil que estamos buscando.  También tendremos en cuenta: Dominio técnico de herramientas de diseño, al menos, del paquete Adobe (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign).  Familiaridad con entornos digitales colaborativos (Google Suite, Slack, Trello u otras equivalentes). Cultura IA y agilidad: curiosidad natural por probar, adaptar e integrar soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial para potenciar el ritmo de producción y la creatividad. Iniciativa, capacidad de organización y comodidad trabajando en equipo y bajo plazos de producción ajustados. ¿Qué te ofrecemos? Tipo de contrato: Indefinido . Queremos incorporar talento al equipo, por lo que no buscamos perfiles freelance.  Salario a convenir según perfil y experiencia , en base a los rangos y roles establecidos en nuestro organigrama interno. Para este perfil, a partir de 24.000€ brutos/año . Modalidad remote first , con flexibilidad horaria y medidas de conciliación.  37,5 horas semanales, con jornada intensiva en julio y agosto de 35 horas. Incorporación a proyectos de comunicación y marketing vinculados a la Administración Pública , con impacto real y mucho margen de aprendizaje. Formarás parte de una agencia certificada B Corp , donde el propósito humano, social y medioambiental está en el centro de nuestro trabajo. Compromiso con la igualdad de oportunidades En XUL nos comprometemos a crear un entorno diverso e inclusivo. Todas las solicitudes de empleo serán consideradas sin distinción de raza, color, religión, género, identidad o expresión de género, orientación sexual, origen nacional, genética, discapacidad o edad. Apreciamos y fomentamos el envío de currículums anonimizados (sin fotografía, fecha de nacimiento o nombre completo) para ayudarnos a garantizar un proceso libre de sesgos.  Cómo aplicar Buscamos un perfil que se pueda incorporar de forma inmediata. Aplica directamente en esta oferta pulsando en «Solicitud sencilla»; no se valorarán candidaturas recibidas por otras vías. No es necesario adjuntar fotografía, fecha de nacimiento o CV completo con todos los datos personales para ser considerado/a.

review_candidates.title: Digital Twin Specialist
review_candidates.description: Responsibilities Develop and enforce Digital Twin technical standards, data governance frameworks, and quality assurance protocols to support reliable analytics and reporting. Lead the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of Digital Twin solutions that integrate physical assets with their virtual counterparts to enable real-time performance monitoring, simulation, and insight generation. Establish and maintain real-time data feeds from sensors, IoT devices, and project systems to continuously update the Digital Twin, ensuring accurate reflection of physical conditions throughout design, construction, and operations. Develop and implement predictive analytics models using historical and real-time data to forecast asset performance, maintenance needs, risk events, and system behaviors. Configure and optimize dashboards, visualization interfaces, and analytics tools for real-time monitoring, alerts, anomaly detection, and decision support. Coordinate with BIM, GIS, IT, sensor/IoT integrators, and data science teams to ensure seamless data architecture, interoperability, and platform integration across systems. Collaborate with project stakeholders (designers, contractors, operators, and client representatives) to capture requirements, define key performance metrics, and ensure Digital Twin outputs support operational and business needs. Support risk identification and mitigation by integrating predictive analytics outputs into project risk management processes. Train project teams on Digital Twin tools, visualization platforms, and analytics interpretation to ensure broad understanding and adoption. Document Digital Twin workflows, integration methodologies, analytics routines, and operational procedures for knowledge transfer and handover. Informs themselves of the relevant Quality, Environmental, Safety and Occupational Health Policies, BIM management Manuals and Procedures in place within Hill International and ensures continued compliance with these requirements while employed by Hill. Develop procedures to facilitate sharing of content and knowledge throughout Hill international. Coordinate with regional office for technical support required to ensure the correctness and completeness of the information production. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Architecture, Computer Science, GIS, or related discipline from a recognized university. Minimum of 10–12 years’ professional experience, with at least 4–6 years directly involved in Digital Twin, smart infrastructure, real-time systems, or advanced analytics on major infrastructure, mixed-use, or smart city projects. Proven experience in implementing Digital Twin solutions that enable real-time monitoring, simulation, and predictive analytics across construction and/or operational environments. Demonstrated experience integrating IoT sensors, monitoring systems, BIM, GIS, and operational platforms into unified analytical environments. Familiarity with data pipelines, cloud platforms, dashboards, and visualization tools used for real-time monitoring and decision support. Experience working in a PMC or client-representative environment is highly desirable. Excellent English communication and reporting skills. Strong report-writing skills for preparing technical documentation, analytical reports, dashboards narratives, and executive-level presentations. About Us Hill International, with more than 4,400+ professionals in over 100 offices worldwide, provides program management, project management, construction management, project management oversight, advisory, facilities management, and other consulting services to clients in a variety of market sectors. Engineering News-Record magazine recently ranked Hill as one of the largest program management firms in the world. For more information on Hill, please visit our website at www.hillintl.com . Hill is exclusively a program, project, and construction management provider, meaning we have one focus as a company: protecting client interests. Free of any potential conflicts, our entire business is geared towards helping clients achieve their desired outcomes. We are dedicated to exceeding expectations throughout the entire construction project lifecycle and adapt to the needs of each assignment to develop tailored approaches and solutions to meet those needs. Hill is a GISI Consulting Group company, part of the Global Infrastructure Solutions, Inc. (GISI) family of companies. Learn more about GISI Consulting Group at www.gisiconsulting.com . Hill International is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Veteran/Disabled Note: This job description is intended to provide an indication of the nature and levels of work, knowledge, skills, abilities and other essential functions to be carried out as part of fulfilling the role mentioned in the job title. Various other duties as required.

review_candidates.title: Regional Project Development Manager for Reciprocation Compressors
review_candidates.description: A Snapshot of Your Day We are seeking a Compressor Regional Project Development Manager (RPDM) for Reciprocating Compressors with a background in reciprocating compressors and proven understanding of driven/driver equipment and related auxiliary systems. This role is part of our dynamic regional service Modernization and Upgrades team in Middle East. Within the Middle East region, we are supporting customers from the Oil & Gas, chemical and industrial sectors. You will be working closely with the regional Client Manager/mechanical & controls RPDM and be responsible for the technical solution as well as the techno-commercial proposal for developed compressor upgrade solutions. This highly networked role requires the ability to work under pressure and meet ambitious deadlines, along with strong people management. How You’ll Make An Impact Actively and methodically explore the market to generate new leads and opportunities. Qualify opportunities for compressor upgrades, working with client managers to develop prospects and secure orders. Collaborate with the Controls Project Development Managers, CM, Service Centers to bring value propositions and navigate complex environments. Lead client communication such as technical presentations on rotating machinery M&U solutions and Siemens Energy's value propositions. Establish and maintain relationships with technical key decision-makers and influencers within client organizations, developing new client relationships through active engagement. Provide technical product training for regional teams, representatives, agents, and clients as required. Meet M&U targets and earning objectives, ensuring a clean handover to execution team. Develop regional technical and commercial proposals in alignment with customer requirements, defining the commercial according to organization’s policies and rules (Price, payment term, T&C’s etc) Prepare and issue Request for Quotations to the relevant major sub-suppliers in support of Siemens Energy bundled “extended scope” solutions) e.g. for site scans, cable laying, foundations, etc.) Work closely with various departments within the organization to collect the necessary information for preparing quotations for extended scope projects (such as site execution, repair center activities, installation, commissioning, and performance testing). Conduct site surveys, including preparation, execution, data collection, risk assessment, and report generation, for designated compressor upgrade projects to identify potential execution risks and establish a sequence of activities for execution. What You Bring Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Engineering with demonstrated ability in rotating machinery in the energy industries, with extensive knowledge in rotating machinery (compressors). Minimum 6 years’ experience as compressor field service/commissioning Engineer or related work experience. Understanding of customer focused equipment and related auxiliary system control upgrade needs, with the ability to inform the factory about upgrade requirements and explain technical solutions to clients. Ability to work collaboratively with diverse teams across organizational and international boundaries, with a strong and confident presence in front of Siemens Energy and client personnel. Self-motivated with high energy drive and business sense, with a good understanding of driven/driver rotating equipment design and thermodynamic principles. Experience with Siemens Energy’s rotating machinery products is preferable, along with an understanding of competition's products and offerings. Willingness to travel when needed, with the ability to present and discuss technical solutions effectively via Microsoft Teams. About The Team Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and integrated execution capabilities. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits Opportunity to work on challenging projects in an exciting environment Opportunity for remote/flexible work Professional support and strong collaboration with colleagues around the world Professional development opportunities within the company https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

review_candidates.title: Ingénieur(e) Système Aeronautique F/H
review_candidates.description: 🚨 ALERTE OPPORTUNITÉ ! 🚨 Rejoignez notre équipe dynamique en tant qu'Ingénieur(e) Système Aéronautique F/H au sein de CHELA+ ! 🌍 Découvrez l'Univers de CHELA+ Fondée en 1997, CHELA+ est bien plus qu'une entreprise. C'est une communauté de passionné(e)s de la technologie, de l'innovation et de l'excellence et nous sommes fiers de notre réputation dans les domaines de l’ingénierie et de l’IT. Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités en île de France dans le secteur de l'aéronautique, nous recrutons un(e) Ingénieur(e) Système Aéronautique F/H. Au sein de CHELA+, vous serez le moteur pour mener à bien nos projets avec succès. Vos Missions au Quotidien : Spécification et définition système Analyser les besoins et les données d'entrée du projet. Participer à la définition de l'architecture et des fonctions du système. Rédiger et maintenir les spécifications système . Définir les exigences fonctionnelles, techniques et d'interface. Définir les interfaces système entre les différents équipements et sous-systèmes. Participer à la définition des IHM et des interfaces homme-machine. Assurer la cohérence et la traçabilité des exigences tout au long du cycle de développement. Participer aux revues de spécification et aux revues techniques. Architecture et interfaces Définir et documenter les interfaces entre les différents éléments du système. Analyser les flux de données et les communications entre équipements. Travailler sur des interfaces et protocoles de communication Participer à l'analyse et à la résolution des problématiques d'interfaces entre équipements. Intégration système Préparer et réaliser l' intégration du système en laboratoire . Participer à la mise en place des moyens d'essais. Configurer les équipements et moyens de test. Réaliser les essais d'intégration et de vérification. Analyser les résultats et identifier les éventuels écarts par rapport aux exigences. Investiguer les anomalies et contribuer à leur résolution. Participer aux campagnes de validation du système. Dans le cadre des activités d'intégration et de diagnostic, vous pourrez être amené(e) à utiliser notamment : Oscilloscopes Analyseurs audio Espions / analyseurs de bus pour les communications 1553, ARINC et Ethernet Et si c’était vous ? Vous êtes de formation ingénieur Bac+5, à dominante Electronique. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X. We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do. You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity. Backend Engineer - Platform - Stacks This role is available for candidates located in the UK, Germany, Spain, Ireland and Sweden. The Opportunity Application Core Services (AppCore) is a group within Platform, in the Foundations department. Foundations produces the Internal Engineering Platform (IEP) and partners closely with our Cloud, Enterprise, and Grafana teams. Our team develops the essential systems driving Grafana's business operations. We utilize the grafana.com platform to engineer bespoke integrations and solutions that unify the diverse technical ecosystem of a modern software enterprise. The team owns important domain areas that help keep both our customer workflows and internal business processes running smoothly. AppCore is made up of multiple squads, each focused on one or more of these domains. Our work includes maintaining the billing engine responsible for customer usage calculation, automating provisioning after a customer signs a contract, integrating with cloud marketplaces such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, and building and maintaining the user portal our customers rely on to manage their accounts. This is a team working at the intersection of product, platform, and business operations. The systems we build are critical to how Grafana scales. We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving complex workflow and systems problems, improving reliability and developer experience, and building software that directly supports both customers and internal stakeholders. As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a unique perspective to the software. Engineers at Grafana also have the opportunity to contribute to Open Source communities and collaborate across teams beyond their immediate scope. What You’ll Be Doing The AppCore Stacks squad owns the systems that create, configure, reconcile, migrate, and operate Grafana Cloud stacks at scale. A stack is the customer-facing Grafana Cloud environment that connects an organization to Grafana and the backend services it uses, including Mimir, Loki, Tempo, plugins, dashboards, data sources, and stack-level configuration. Our work sits at the intersection of product, platform, and operations.
